source_roles: The bundled original Adobe Symbol table supplies glyph-role names and private values; Mozilla documents top/middle/bottom/glue assembly roles. Unicode technical-symbol names/classes corroborate non-RTL component roles. LibreOffice records later codepoint assignments, which are not used as output substitutions here.
scope: Twenty named parenthesis/bracket/brace/integral assembly parts. Require original Type0/IdentityH/CIDToGIDIdentity, agreeing PDF/program Symbol names, Microsoft Symbol cmap GID, exact ToUnicode, all-source multiplicity and unique SDK cells. An identity alias retains raw PUA and keeps requires_review=true even after inventory verification; it is not Unicode semantic recovery.
excluded: No arbitrary PUA, MT Extra, delta/mu ambiguity, radical or arrow extenders. Do not map these components to whole parentheses, floor/ceiling operators or modern Unicode component characters. Unknown/unowned/ActualText collisions still reject the page projection.
copied_material: Only factual role/code relationships and references; no external source code, font program, outlines or full mapping table copied.
